limitations: Opposed geometric/mean vertex normals can explain shading artifacts but do not prove holes or inward surfaces.
Thin triangles can be intentional; no arbitrary artistic pass/fail threshold is applied.
Counts are unique local meshes, not transformed instances. No UV overlap, intersection, manifold or texture certification.
Checks decoded PNG/JPEG images, references and declared UV shape/count, not UV overlap, texel density, shader fidelity or artistic detail.
Resolution and decoded pixel hashes do not establish AI detail, PBR plausibility or Meshy equivalence. No texture or source is modified.

generation.scope: Actual cached TRELLIS v1 and original-normal Hi3DGen, two seeds each, same retained castle RGBA. Geometry only; no PBR, commercial approval, Meshy parity or production promotion. Mask lineage is the prior evaluation-only TRELLIS2 run. CPU Blender clay comparison follows in a separate command.
generation.recovery: First neural stage completed; initial inspection interrupted after diagnosing quadratic missing-normal fallback. Real outputs retained and reinspected using the repaired validator, not regenerated.

clay.mode: Same 10m diagnostic height, CPU Cycles16, 512 square, neutral clay, same lights/cameras. Scale normalization is for comparison only, not measured game dimensions. No source/export mutation, PBR or artistic score.

telemetry_limit: First original v1 seed42 whole-GPU samples were lost when its quadratic API inspection was interrupted. Its measured Torch peaks remain in generation.json. Supplemental same-setting repeat has a separate actual whole-GPU trace and slightly different geometry, not a retroactive measurement of the original.
reproducibility_limit: The supplemental v1 seed42 result has 1269620 triangles versus 1269640 originally and a different GLB hash. A fixed seed is not proof of bit-identical geometry. Cause not isolated; neither original model was overwritten.
decision: Keep current production defaults. V1 and Hi3DGen remain research geometry-only; no PBR advantage, commercial clearance, Meshy parity or user artistic approval established.
